import sys

    MOD = 998244353

    A = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    # f[j][i] : list indexed by length
    f = [[None]*n for _ in range(n)]
    ans = [0]*(n+1)
    ans[1] = n % MOD
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i):
            cur = [0]*(n+1)
            cur[2] = 1
            d = A[i] - A[j]
            for p in range(j):
                if A[j] - A[p] == d:
                    fp = f[p][j]

    # length 2 counted via cur[2] sums = C(n,2)

from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    MOD = 998244353
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    ans = [0]*(n+1)
    ans[1] = n % MOD
    if n >= 2:
        ans[2] = (n*(n-1)//2) % MOD
    # dp[i][j] : list indexed by length
    dp = [[None]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for j in range(n):
        # aggregate incoming
        agg = defaultdict(lambda: [0]*(n+2))
        for i in range(j):
            d = A[j]-A[i]
            vec = dp[i][j]
            tgt = agg[d]
            for L in range(2, n+1):
                if vec[L]:
                    tgt[L] = (tgt[L] + vec[L]) % MOD
        for k in range(j+1, n):
            d = A[k]-A[j]
            cur = [0]*(n+2)
            cur[2] = 1
            if d in agg:
                src = agg[d]
                for L in range(2, n):
                    cur[L+1] = src[L]
            dp[j][k] = cur
            for L in range(2, n+1):
                if cur[L]:
                    ans[L] = (ans[L] + cur[L]) % MOD
    print(" ".join(str(ans[k] % MOD) for k in range(1, n+1)))
